functions.name: confirm_hero
functions.description: Locks in your hero and enters Whispering Meadow.

workshopRecipes.title: Quiver of 5 Rune Arrows
workshopRecipes.description: Use a `for` loop to forge 5 stackable Rune Arrows (5 Shards each = 25 Shards).

workshopRecipes.title: Smart Shard Shopper
workshopRecipes.description: Check `get_shards()` with `if`/`elif`/`else` to automatically forge the best gear you can afford!

workshopRecipes.title: Reusable Loadout Builder
workshopRecipes.description: Define a `def` function that equips gear and crafts a custom number of arrows & potions.
workshopRecipes.starterCode:
# Define a reusable adventure loadout function!
def build_loadout(arrows, potions):
    forge_arrows(arrows)
    brew_potion(potions)

build_loadout(3, 1)

workshopRecipes.title: Custom Relic Blueprint
workshopRecipes.description: Create your own Python `class` with `.name` and `.power`, then pass an instance to `forge_custom()`!
workshopRecipes.starterCode:
# Design your own Relic class and forge it!
class Relic:
    def __init__(self, name, power):
        self.name = name
        self.power = power

my_relic = Relic("Dragonfang Blade", 10)
forge_custom(my_relic)

workshopChallenges.title: Quiver Math Review
workshopChallenges.prompt: Set `quivers = 3` and `arrows_per_quiver = 6`, compute `total_arrows = quivers * arrows_per_quiver`, and print `total_arrows`.
workshopChallenges.starterCode:
# Calculate the total arrows across 3 quivers of 6
quivers = 3
arrows_per_quiver = 6
workshopChallenges.testCode:
assert total_arrows == 18, f'Expected total_arrows == 18, got {total_arrows!r}'
assert OUTPUT.strip() == '18', f'Expected output "18", got {OUTPUT.strip()!r}'

workshopChallenges.title: Bram's Bargain Check
workshopChallenges.prompt: Given `shards = 40` and `price = 35`, use `if`/`else` to print `"Forge it!"` if `shards >= price`, otherwise print `"Keep saving!"`.
workshopChallenges.starterCode:
shards = 40
price = 35
# Write an if/else check below:
workshopChallenges.testCode: assert OUTPUT.strip() == 'Forge it!', f'Expected "Forge it!", got {OUTPUT.strip()!r}'

workshopChallenges.title: Anvil Rhythm Loop
workshopChallenges.prompt: Use a `for` loop over the word `"BRAM"` to print each letter with `"!"` glued on the end, one per line.
workshopChallenges.starterCode: # Use a for loop to print B!, R!, A!, and M! on separate lines
workshopChallenges.testCode:
lines = [l.strip() for l in OUTPUT.strip().splitlines()]
assert lines == ['B!', 'R!', 'A!', 'M!'], f'Got {lines!r}'

workshopChallenges.title: Forge Cost Function
workshopChallenges.prompt: Write a function `bundle_cost(arrows, potions)` that returns `arrows * 5 + potions * 10`, then print `bundle_cost(4, 2)`.
workshopChallenges.starterCode: # Define bundle_cost(arrows, potions) and print bundle_cost(4, 2)
workshopChallenges.testCode:
assert callable(bundle_cost), 'Define bundle_cost(arrows, potions)!'
assert bundle_cost(4, 2) == 40, f'Expected 40, got {bundle_cost(4, 2)!r}'
assert bundle_cost(1, 3) == 35, f'Expected 35 for (1, 3), got {bundle_cost(1, 3)!r}'
assert OUTPUT.strip() == '40', f'Expected output "40", got {OUTPUT.strip()!r}'

workshopChallenges.title: Masterwork Relic Class
workshopChallenges.prompt: Create a class `Relic` whose `__init__(self, name, power)` stores `self.name` and `self.power`, and a `describe(self)` method returning `f"{self.name}: {self.power}"`. Create `r = Relic("Sunburst", 9)` and print `r.describe()`.
workshopChallenges.starterCode: # Build the Relic class and print r.describe()
workshopChallenges.testCode:
test_r = Relic('Moonbeam', 7)
assert test_r.name == 'Moonbeam' and test_r.power == 7
assert test_r.describe() == 'Moonbeam: 7', f'Expected "Moonbeam: 7", got {test_r.describe()!r}'
assert OUTPUT.strip() == 'Sunburst: 9', f'Expected "Sunburst: 9", got {OUTPUT.strip()!r}'
